fields.name: SqlConnectionConfiguration connection-resolution library surface
fields.contract: SqlConnectionConfiguration accepts up to four ambient SQL Server property layers (global, shard-set, read/write, and shard) and local properties. It exposes an operation that returns the resolved SQL Server connection string and a property that returns the resolved endpoint description. Later applicable layers take precedence over earlier layers; its local properties take final precedence. Ambient property changes cause the next connection-string request to resolve again.
